reviews.text: 大约一个半小时即可通关，角色塑造都还可以,剧情也还行，关键它还免费，这还说啥，这波我给到夯！！！ 建议玩下这个工作室的其他游戏!!!!!

经典后小圆魔法少女故事
[h1]一款有趣的游戏[/h1] 内容短小，但是世界观有点意思，不过剧情挺短的，从头过到尾大概只要1小时，挺简单的，但是我觉得战斗有点难；不过战斗时的音乐蛮好听的
很好玩的小品级益智类游戏，连剧情都稍微有深度。谁还会对免费游戏又没内购要素的点差评呢。看到还有后续开发，希望作品越做越好。
这种塔防模式还挺新颖挺好玩的
蛮新颖，齿轮好用（带那个吸附的配件然后多升级攻速） 不过流程短，剧情简陋 好玩是确实的 像素风，喜欢 免费我无疑是兴奋的😋
像素画风和角色很好看 玩法是塔防，不过有一点自己的特色：可以移动塔的位置来构筑结界，攻击来袭的怪物潮。随着流程推进，还能切换不同攻击模式和天赋搭配，玩起来不会太单调。 免费的挺不错，差不多1小时半左右可以全成就。
Cute short story. Gameplay is essentially a tower defense game. Loved the pixel art and the music. Magical girls are always a plus! For a free game I definitely recommend it.
A small fun game, has diffrent ways to play and didn't feel like I was forced to play a certain way.

It started off slow with a lot exposition, but once I got to the actual gameplay, it was really good. I really liked trying out all the different weapon types. I'm looking forward to trying out Nightmare mode at some point.

This is a really cool little game! The story vibes are... Well, exactly as expected for this genre, rather depressing. It was a compelling story nonetheless! The gameplay is very unique, not sure I have ever seen a tower defense game quite like this. Full marks for creativity ^^
There is not a whole lot to this short game, but what is here is solid, interesting tower defense with a good art style and a simple, on-theme story.
Short and sweet with some interesting mechanics. If you like dark magical girl stories, this is a decent one.

Really nice little game, with a simple, yet moving story. You can easily predict it if you know the genre, but it felt good anyway. Gameplay is good, especially with a LOST track on it (really liked it). The only thing I missed is hints to some hidden achievements, but that's not truly important. And thanks for the game being free - developer could actually set a little price on it, but I finished the game in 1.5 hours, so people could refund it and free price is understandable in this scenario. Nevertheless - great little game, really had fun.

I don't really play games for the difficulty, so I can't really say anything about that. What I _can_ say is that the story is beautiful. It is short, yeah. But its just so good! I thought it would be more sinister, but just as it is, I can feel how much care went into it. I love those Devs, I am following for every new game. I wouldn't even complain if they decided to launch something paid. Great Work! I know I'll come back to play again and again, in greater difficulties, just because the game feels good to play.
So so well done and cute! it was an absolute joy to play and honestly super underrated, I hope the developers make more games like this!

Fun short game, and its for free! I REALLY liked the pixel art and the music. As a fan of the magical girl genre, I really enjoyed how the story opens, but I do feel like the ending is rushed and should've been paced slower. Maybe add one more "episode"/chapter in between the second-to-last and last one? Still, I'm glad I played it. I don't believe I've played a game with the mechanics that it uses here, and found myself engaged! Veteran aka Normal difficulty is satisfying in that there were some challenges, but none that were egregious and the dopamine hit my brain good when I beat a challenging level.
只需用四个字描述这个游戏：浅尝辄止 与其说是塔防倒不如说是即时半动作小游戏，完全没有配置防守的感觉，激光齿轮纯属花里胡哨，炮塔动来动去纯因数值有用。本来当个泡面消遣小游戏也挺好的吧，非要搞这种不上不下的三流自以为是黑深残故事，结果还是造作的馒头卡那一套，还不如往社畜和守护城市这个方向做个简单的故事。 唯一的优点就是免费，还好是免费的体量小，不然开发者有时间往这个剧情加水那无聊程度恐怕要加倍

I can not believe all the positive reviews this game is getting. Although if you like being depressed while playing a mediocre game then maybe this is for you. The game is half game, half story. The game play itself is ok. Not fantastic, not terrible. Frankly there are numerous free browser tower defense games out there that are much better. Spoiler alerts ahead. stop reading if you don't want the story spoiled. Where the game really falls short is the story is depressing af with no way to achieve a happy ending. You can't win. You die a seemingly pointless unhappy death after everyone you care about gets their positive emotions sucked away and/or dies. What's worse the story itself doesn't entirely make sense. There's also a ton of pointless button clicking to give the impression like you have rpg story choices but it's an illusion. There's only one thing you can ever click on so making players click on the bed, door, phone, etc is pointless. The only real choices you have are regarding game play, ie what towers you can select for your missions and what perks those towers get. I wish I had read a review like this before downloading this thing. I will now publish the review and remove the game from my library.
故事很简洁，玩法还算有趣
这个制作组无敌！

The game seems somewhat short—it took me an hour and a half to complete, at least following the direct route—but it is highly engaging. The desings and scenarios are good; they are simple, but well made. The story is reminiscent of Madoka Magica (and is likely inspired by it), yet it possesses its own depth, featuring natural-feeling character interactions as the cast tries to balance their busy lives. Personally, I really liked the night-time city scene; it conveyed—as has already been noted—a sense of melancholy, yet one that was simultaneously nostalgic and cheerful. Anyways, the game overall is a good game, everyone should give it a try; it doesn't take that much time and it's free, a simple magical girls game that throws you to a history that is a bit depressing.
Very fun short game. It's so stylish! I wish it was longer, but I had a lot of fun with it anyway. It left me wanting more.
I just wish I could have paid for it to be a longer game! The art and basic music was so good. The gameplay was super fun and unique, the magical girl theme remains one of my favorites! I loved it!
super fun short little game! criminal it doesn't have a price tag. hope there will be more some day. being meguca is suffering.
Very short but fun game with easy to understand mechanics. Its free and takes about an hour to beat on easier difficulties.
It's short, it's solid, it's got something to say, and some mechanical ideas you probably haven't seen before.
Not much to say, really. You get what you see in the trailer and, at least for me, that was fun.

Very well designed game. The combat system was fun, almost like a slight hint of starcraft mixed with a TDF game. It has a good story, especially for the game's length. I hope the devs keep working on this and similar projects!

A nice story-driven defense game. The quieter story moments balance the action well, making players feel more empathy for both the characters and the world they protect.
I Recommend This Game
Dear Magical Girls offers a fresh take on the magical girl genre. I appreciated the character development and engaging storyline that kept me invested throughout the game.
I enjoyed the strategic elements of combat in Dear Magical Girls. The challenging battles required me to think critically and adapt my tactics, which added depth to the gameplay.
A creative defense game with a unique barrier-shaping mechanic and a touching magical girl story. A great pick for strategy fans.
I enjoyed the adventure and the humor, but I encountered some bugs that disrupted my playthrough. It has potential but needs polishing.
The characters were well-developed, and I appreciated the narrative twists. However, the pacing was a bit slow for my taste.
Dear Magical Girls offers an interesting blend of storytelling and strategy but can feel repetitive after a while. Worth a try for fans of the genre.
The game has a unique concept and interesting dialogue, yet the combat mechanics felt lacking. It's an enjoyable game but not without flaws.
Dear Magical Girls offers an engaging narrative with well-developed characters. I appreciated the blend of fantasy elements and emotional depth throughout my playthrough.
